content:
Mara: Quick heads-up - we've got a customer vignette ready for launch with Kestrel Labs. Need to coordinate interview recording, one short launch post, and quote/legal checks. Suggested embargo: next Tues 10am PT.
Julien: Can we lock a 30m recording slot this week? Prefer Thurs morning.
Sam: I can take the interview. Thurs 10:30am PT works for me.
Priya: Putting time on calendar. Do we have the draft quote from the customer or should we pull one from the interview?
Mara: They sent a short blurb in email earlier. Copy pasted below for legal review: "Kestrel Labs reduced inference cost by ~45% and cut 99th percentile latency in half after migrating to Redwood."
Anita: Looks good but will flag any claims that need backup. LegalBot can you run the standard claims checklist?
LegalBot: Running checklist: request supporting benchmark data, confirm benchmark methodology, ensure customer consent for numbers. Missing: benchmark artifact and a signed quote approval.
Mara: Copy - I'll ask Kestrel for the benchmark CSV and a quick approval email to sign off.
Julien: Also want a short benchmark blurb for the blog: can we get the before/after throughput numbers? e.g., "from 130 TPS to 230 TPS" - concrete numbers better than percentages.
Sam: I'll ask about before/after TPS and 95th/99th latency. If they can't share exact numbers, ask for ranges and permission to publish percent improvements.
Priya: Calendar invites sent. Recording zoom link in the doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1kestrel-vignette
Mara: Draft release post is in that doc under Marketing > Drafts. Copy of the customer quote block for the post:
"Redwood's routing and caching cut our token costs nearly in half while keeping latency predictable. The team was able to ship the feature without adding ops overhead." - Priya Sharma, VP Eng, Kestrel Labs
Julien: Can we shorten that for the social post? Suggest: "Redwood cut our inference costs ~50% and helped us ship faster."
Anita: Legal: shorten is fine but still need signoff on the cost number. Also please remove any proprietary process details from the quote.
Mara: Action items: 1) Sam requests benchmark artifacts and permission for numbers (today) 2) Kestrel to send signed approval email for the quote (by EOD Friday) 3) Legal will confirm claim language once artifacts arrive.
Sam: Request sent - email cc'ing Mara and Anita.
Priya: Creative: can we get a 30-60s customer clip during the interview for the launch post? Quick B-roll for social.
Julien: Yes, add a short "what changed" question to the script.
Mara: Script snippet added to doc: Q: What was the single biggest outcome after switching to Redwood? A: (30s max) "We halved costs and kept latency stable, which let us move faster on product features."
Anita: One more legal note: embargo confirmed? If marketing wants an embargo, legal needs the date and to confirm the customer agrees.
Mara: Embargo proposed next Tues 10am PT - Kestrel ok'd it verbally, will get written ok in the signoff email.
LegalBot: Checklist update pending receipt of benchmark file and explicit written embargo consent.
Sam: If we don't get numbers by EOD tomorrow, we can still publish with percent improvements if customer agrees to non-specific language (~50% not exact). Plan B noted.
Julien: Plan B ok.
Priya: I'll prepare the social cut templates and the webinar invite for a deeper technical session (tentative Nov 9). Routing question: which SDR team should get inbound MQLs from the launch?
Mara: Route to the APAC inbound queue + assign to the platform solutions team for demo. Tag lead with case-kestrel in CRM.
Sam: Adding an Ops checklist: model name, pinned version, region, prewarm policy. Template in doc.
Mara: Great. Follow-ups: Sam to confirm benchmarks, Kestrel to send signed quote + embargo consent, Legal/Anita to confirm language, Julien to finalize social copy, Priya to prepare assets. If all green, schedule publish for Tue 10am PT. :thumbsup:
Anita: I'll review immediately when the artifacts arrive.
Kestrel: We approve the testimonial and embargo for next Tue at 10am PT. Attached benchmark CSV.
Mara: Received - attaching to the doc and tagging Legal. Moving to final signoff thread after Legal confirms.
LegalBot: Received benchmark CSV. Initial check: methodology documented, numbers consistent. Legal signoff pending explicit approval of final copy.
Mara: Thanks everyone - follow-ups in the doc. I'll file the final signoff note here when done. :party_parrot:
